defaultFade.Name: Default fade (ms)
defaultFade.Hint: Crossfade length when a soundscape does not set its own.

stopUnmanaged.Name: Switching takes over all music & ambience
stopUnmanaged.Hint: When a soundscape starts, fade out every Music and Ambient playlist sound that isn't part of it, including ones you started by hand from the Playlists sidebar.

narrateLevel.Name: Narrate: duck level
narrateLevel.Hint: Music and ambience volume while Narrate is on (fraction of normal).

padDuckLevel.Name: Pad ducking level
padDuckLevel.Hint: How far music and ambience dip under a pad marked 'Duck'.

muffleCutoff.Name: Muffle: cutoff frequency (Hz)
muffleCutoff.Hint: Lower = more muffled (behind a door, underwater).

uploadFolder.Name: Upload folder
uploadFolder.Hint: Where sound files you drag in from your computer are stored (inside your Foundry Data folder). Each soundscape gets its own subfolder.

sceneAutoplay.Name: Start linked soundscapes on scene activation
sceneAutoplay.Hint: When you activate a scene that a soundscape is linked to, that soundscape starts.

combatAuto.Name: Switch to the combat soundscape when combat begins
combatAuto.Hint: Returns to the previous soundscape when the encounter is ended.

muffled.Label: Muffled
muffled.Hint: Behind a door, the next room

vastHall.Label: Vast Hall
vastHall.Hint: A cathedral, a throne room, the void between worlds

ethereal.Label: Ethereal
ethereal.Hint: Spirits, the border of the dead, a voice from beyond

deafened.Label: Deafened
deafened.Hint: A thunderclap or an explosion; recovers by itself

sending.Label: Sending
sending.Hint: Magical messages, scrying, a voice through a crystal

Panel.NarrateTooltip: Duck music & ambience while you read (Alt+N)
Panel.NoScapes: No soundscapes yet. Click New to build your first one, e.g. “Tavern”, “City streets”, “Combat”.
Panel.ClickHint: Click: crossfade · Shift-click: layer on top / remove layer
Panel.NoCueListHint: A cue list is a session's running order: each cue bundles actions (switch soundscape, fire a pad, turn a filter on, run a macro) and GO (Alt+G) fires the next one. Put @Cue[name] in a journal page to get a ▶ button in your read-aloud text.
Panel.CueClickHint: Click: make this the next cue
Panel.ListEmpty: This list is empty. Click Edit to add cues.
Panel.DeleteScapeText: Delete {name}? The playlists and sounds it uses are not touched.
Panel.DeleteListText: Delete the cue list {name} and its {n} cue(s)?

Editor.Title: Soundscape: {name}
Editor.GlobalHint: Pads that are always available, whatever soundscape is playing. Drag sounds or playlists from the Playlists sidebar, or files from your computer, onto this section.
Editor.Name: Name
Editor.Sticky: Sticky layer: stays on when you switch soundscapes (for weather, a heartbeat…)
Editor.MusicDrop: drop a playlist, a track, or a file from your computer
Editor.PlaylistModeHint: Plays in the playlist's own mode ({mode}). Set shuffle or sequential on the playlist itself.
Editor.AmbienceSub: start with the scape, loop until it changes
Editor.AmbienceEmpty: Drop sounds, a whole playlist, or files from your computer here, or add one below.
Editor.ScatterEmpty: e.g. a distant bell every 30–90 s, ravens, a door slamming somewhere. Drop files here to make a layer.
Editor.PadsSub: buttons you fire by hand · Alt+1…9
Editor.PadsEmpty: Drop files from your computer (one pad each), a sound, or a playlist (one pad with random variants).

CueEditor.Title: Cue list: {name}
CueEditor.Hint: Each cue runs its actions from top to bottom; Wait pauses between them. Auto-follow fires the next cue that many seconds after this one finishes. copies a journal link like @Cue[The dragon arrives]: paste it into a journal page and it becomes a ▶ button only you can see.
CueEditor.AutoFollowHint: Fire the next cue automatically, this many seconds after this one finishes
CueEditor.NotesPlaceholder: Notes for you (shown in the cue list)

Notify.GMOnly: only the GM can use the soundboard.
Notify.Preloading: preloading {n} sound(s) for “{name}” on all clients.
Notify.HeavyFiles: “{name}” has {n} heavy file(s) for players to download: {files}. Convert them to OGG (96–128 kbps) to keep everyone's connection smooth.
Notify.NoCueList: no cue list yet. Create one in the Cues tab.
Notify.LinkCopied: copied {link}. Paste it into a journal page.
Notify.DropPlaylist: drop a playlist or a playlist sound from the Playlists sidebar.
Notify.SceneClash: “{name}” was also linked to that scene; the first one found will play.
Notify.NotAudio: those don't look like audio files (mp3, ogg, wav, flac, webm, m4a…).
Notify.NoUpload: your user isn't allowed to upload files.
